stories.headline: US completes 11th straight night of strikes on Iran; Tehran hits bases in Kuwait, Bahrain, Jordan

key_facts.fact: US Central Command said it completed its 11th consecutive night of air strikes on Iran early Wednesday, targeting military operations centers, maritime capabilities, aircraft hangars, drone storage facilities and logistics infrastructure to degrade Iran's ability to threaten shipping in the Strait of Hormuz.
key_facts.excerpt: CENTCOM said US forces targeted 'Iranian military operations centres, maritime capabilities, aircraft hangars, drone storage facilities, and military logistics infrastructure'.

key_facts.fact: In retaliation, Iran's military said on Wednesday it struck US-linked sites in Kuwait, Jordan and Bahrain, including drone attacks on ammunition depots and a ground-forces command center in the Doha garrison in western Kuwait.
key_facts.excerpt: Iran's military said on Wednesday that it hit US-linked sites in Kuwait, Jordan and Bahrain... targeted the 'ammunition depots' and 'logistics equipment of the ground forces command centre' of the criminal US army in the Doha garrison in western Kuwait with a large number of its destructive drones.

key_facts.fact: The newest barrage came after President Trump telegraphed that strikes would intensify and said the US would hit Iran's secretive Pickaxe Mountain nuclear site 'pretty soon.'
key_facts.excerpt: The newest barrage came after President Donald Trump telegraphed that strikes would be intensifying.

key_facts.fact: Iran's top joint military command warned that any US attack on its nuclear sites would lead to an 'expansion of war,' with all US and allied interests in the region targeted in response.
key_facts.excerpt: Iran's top joint military command warned on Tuesday that any U.S. attack on the country's nuclear sites would lead to an 'expansion of war' in the region.

key_facts.fact: Israel is drawing up operational plans for possible escalation but remains on the sidelines with no imminent plans to join; Washington has not asked Israel to enter the campaign, three Israeli sources said.
key_facts.excerpt: Israel is drawing up operational plans for a further escalation in the US-Iran conflict, three Israeli sources said, but for now remains on the sidelines and has no imminent plans to join.

key_facts.fact: CENTCOM said Iran had attacked more than 30 commercial vessels transiting the Strait of Hormuz over the past three months, but claimed the waterway remains open for commercial traffic.
key_facts.excerpt: over the past three months, Iran had 'attacked more than 30 commercial vessels transiting the international waterway'... the Strait of Hormuz 'remains open for commercial vessel transit'.

stories.headline: Zelensky replaces military chief Syrskyi with Gen. Drapatyi in biggest command shake-up of the war

key_facts.fact: President Volodymyr Zelensky announced he had dismissed four-star Gen. Oleksandr Syrskyi, 60, as commander-in-chief and appointed Maj. Gen. Mykhailo Drapatyi, 43, to lead the Armed Forces of Ukraine.
key_facts.excerpt: Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has dismissed four-star General Oleksandr Syrskyi as commander-in-chief and appointed Major General Mykhailo Drapatyi to replace him.

key_facts.fact: It is the biggest shake-up of Ukraine's military leadership since Russia's full-scale invasion.
key_facts.excerpt: Zelenskyy has named a young general, Mykhailo Drapatyi, as the commander-in-chief of Ukraine's military in the biggest shake-up of country's military leadership since Russia invaded.

key_facts.fact: The change followed days of street protests sparked by Zelensky's earlier sacking of popular, tech-savvy defense minister Mykhailo Fedorov, and a rift between the outgoing army chief and the defense minister.
key_facts.excerpt: a rift between the country's outgoing army chief and its defense minister threatened to derail its efforts. Both men lost their jobs following Zelenskyy's major government reshuffle last week.

key_facts.fact: Zelensky said the General Staff would be reorganized and that the decisions would be formalized on July 22, saying Ukraine 'must emerge from this situation stronger.'
key_facts.excerpt: 'Tomorrow we will formalize all decisions. Ukraine must emerge from this situation stronger, and it will become harder for Russia,' Zelensky said.

key_facts.fact: Drapatyi led Ukraine's land forces from 2024 to 2025 and built his reputation as a daring commander from the early days of the war against Russian aggression in 2014.
key_facts.excerpt: Mr Zelenskyy replaced former commander-in-chief, Oleksandr Syrskyi, 60, with General Drapatyi, 43, a respected and experienced commander who led the country's land forces from 2024 to 2025.

stories.headline: SpaceX launches Northrop Grumman's first robotic satellite-servicing vehicle to extend GEO satellites

key_facts.fact: A SpaceX Falcon 9 launched July 21 at 5:15 p.m. EDT from Cape Canaveral Space Force Station carrying Northrop Grumman's Mission Robotic Vehicle (MRV) and three Mission Extension Pods toward geostationary transfer orbit.
key_facts.excerpt: A Falcon 9 rocket carrying a Mission Robotic Vehicle, or MRV, and three Mission Extension Pods lifted off at 5:15 p.m. Eastern from Cape Canaveral Space Force Station in Florida.

key_facts.fact: The MRV is designed to install propulsion modules on aging satellites in geostationary orbit, extending the life of a typical satellite by roughly six years, and can move between clients over an operating life of about 15 years.
key_facts.excerpt: extend the lives of multiple satellites by installing propulsion modules in geostationary orbit... can allow a satellite low on fuel to continue operating... a typical geostationary satellite by roughly six years.

key_facts.fact: Northrop calls the 3,000 kg MRV-1 America's first multi-mission robotic service vehicle, equipped with two three-meter, seven-degree-of-freedom robotic arms built by the US Naval Research Laboratory and able to service up to thirty 2,000 kg satellites.
key_facts.excerpt: MRV-1 will be America's first multi-mission robotic service vehicle capable of performing crucial life extension, inspection, repairs, and disposal... an on-orbit satellite service vehicle that can extend the life of up to thirty 2,000 kg satellites.

key_facts.fact: The first pods are intended to service satellites owned by Australia-based Optus and Luxembourg-based SES.
key_facts.excerpt: the MRV will begin the process of installing MEPs onto clients' spacecraft, including those owned by Australia-based company Optus and Luxembourg-based company SES.

key_facts.fact: Because the mission needed the booster's full performance, SpaceX did not recover the first stage, ending booster B1069's service after a record 32nd flight.
key_facts.excerpt: SpaceX did not attempt to recover the first stage, ending its service after a record 32 flights.

stories.headline: France becomes first EU country to pass a ban on social media for under-15s

key_facts.fact: France's parliament passed a bill on July 21 barring children under 15 from social media, with the National Assembly approving it 279 to 81 after the Senate voted earlier the same day.
key_facts.excerpt: After approval by the Senate earlier Tuesday, members of the National Assembly passed the bill by 279 votes to 81.

key_facts.fact: The measure makes France the first EU country to approve a blanket ban on social media for under-15s.
key_facts.excerpt: The measure will make France the first country in the European Union to approve a blanket ban on social media.

key_facts.fact: The ban rolls out in two stages: under-15s cannot create new accounts from September 1, 2026, and existing accounts must be closed from January 1, 2027.
key_facts.excerpt: younger teens won't be able to create new social media accounts from 1 September, while the ban will apply to existing accounts from 1 January 2027.

key_facts.fact: The law also bans mobile phones in most high schools, extending existing restrictions in middle and primary schools, and requires platforms to implement age verification overseen by France's privacy regulator.
key_facts.excerpt: The bill would also ban the use of mobile phones in high schools and require social media platforms to introduce age verification measures in accordance with France's privacy regulator.

key_facts.fact: President Emmanuel Macron, who championed the ban and will sign it into law, called parliament's approval 'a major step forward.'
key_facts.excerpt: French lawmakers overwhelmingly voted in favor of the bill, which was strongly backed by France's President Emmanuel Macron. He will now sign it into law.

stories.headline: Arrowhead's plozasiran cuts triglycerides ~80% in Phase 3, plans US filing this year

key_facts.fact: Arrowhead Pharmaceuticals announced July 22 that its global Phase 3 SHASTA-3 and SHASTA-4 studies of plozasiran in severe hypertriglyceridemia both met the primary endpoint and all prespecified secondary endpoints.
key_facts.excerpt: SHASTA-3 and SHASTA-4 successfully met the primary endpoint of triglyceride reduction versus placebo and met all prespecified secondary endpoints in both studies.

key_facts.fact: Plozasiran, dosed subcutaneously once every three months, produced median triglyceride reductions of 79% and 81% at month 12, versus about 27% for placebo.
key_facts.excerpt: 25 mg plozasiran administered as a subcutaneous injection once every three months led to median triglyceride reductions of 79% and 81%, respectively, at month 12, versus a placebo reduction of approximately 27%.

key_facts.fact: A pooled analysis showed a statistically significant reduction in acute pancreatitis events, with cumulative events cut 78% versus placebo across the broad population and a 100% reduction in the highest-risk patients.
key_facts.excerpt: cumulative AP events were reduced by 78% in treated patients versus placebo... plozasiran treatment demonstrated a 100% reduction in AP events versus placebo.

key_facts.fact: Roughly 750 participants were randomized across the two studies, and Arrowhead said it plans to file a supplemental new drug application with the US FDA before the end of 2026.
key_facts.excerpt: approximately 750 participants were randomized... Our first planned filing is an sNDA in the U.S. before the end of the year.

key_facts.fact: Plozasiran (marketed as REDEMPLO) is already approved in the US, EU, China, Australia and Canada for familial chylomicronemia syndrome; detailed results will be presented at the European Society of Cardiology Congress in Munich on August 30.
key_facts.excerpt: Plozasiran has received regulatory approval, as REDEMPLO, in the United States, the European Union, China, Australia, and Canada... presented as a HOT LINE Late Breaker at the European Society of Cardiology (ESC) Congress in Munich on August 30, 2026.

stories.headline: Science Corp wins EU approval for Prima bionic eye that restores sight in macular degeneration

key_facts.fact: Science Corporation announced July 22 the European commercial launch of PRIMA after receiving a CE mark under the EU Medical Device Regulation from DEKRA, authorizing availability across 30 European countries.
key_facts.excerpt: PRIMA has received a CE (Conformite Europeenne) mark under the European Union Medical Device Regulation from DEKRA, authorizing its commercial availability across 30 European countries.

key_facts.fact: PRIMA is the first brain-computer interface device to receive CE marking for form vision restoration, letting patients read letters, numbers and words.
key_facts.excerpt: It marks the first BCI device to receive CE mark for form vision restoration (reading letters, numbers and words).

key_facts.fact: The implant-and-glasses system restores functional central vision to patients with geographic atrophy caused by age-related macular degeneration, a leading cause of blindness.
key_facts.excerpt: Prima... restores functional central vision to patients with geographic atrophy (GA) caused by age-related macular degeneration (AMD), a leading cause of blindness.

key_facts.fact: Science is led by founder and CEO Max Hodak, who also co-founded Elon Musk-backed Neuralink; the first commercial Prima implant is expected in Germany soon.
key_facts.excerpt: Science, led by founder Max Hodak, who also co-founded Elon Musk-backed BCI company Neuralink... It expects the first commercial Prima implant to take place in Germany soon.

key_facts.fact: PRIMA remains investigational in the US, where it holds FDA breakthrough device designation, and Science has secured more than $490 million in capital, including a $230 million Series C in March.
key_facts.excerpt: Prima remains investigational in the U.S. as Science works with the FDA... It currently holds FDA breakthrough device designation... more than $490 million in capital secured to date. That includes $230 million raised in a March Series C round.

stories.headline: White House unveils plan to steer US research funding from universities to individual scientists and AI

key_facts.fact: OSTP Director Michael Kratsios released the report 'Science: A New Golden Age' on July 21, billed as the first comprehensive rethinking of the US science enterprise in over 80 years since Vannevar Bush's 1945 'Science: The Endless Frontier.'
key_facts.excerpt: The report, entitled Science: A New Golden Age, marks the first comprehensive rethinking of the U.S. science and technology enterprise in over 80 years since Vannevar Bush's Science: The Endless Frontier.

key_facts.fact: The plan would refocus federal R&D support on individual scientists rather than legacy institutions, using portable grants that follow the researcher and diversifying funding beyond slow consensus peer review.
key_facts.excerpt: Its fix is to send more support to individual researchers and to widen how the government awards money... portable awards modeled on the National Science Foundation's graduate fellowships, which a researcher keeps when switching institutions.

key_facts.fact: The strategy is aimed at shaping roughly $200 billion in annual federal research and development spending for the rest of Trump's term.
key_facts.excerpt: OSTP's Tuesday report and memo are best read as an attempt to steer the executive branch's research posture... aimed at an R&D budget of roughly $200 billion a year.

key_facts.fact: A third pillar calls to fully fund and scale the Genesis Mission as the flagship national AI-for-science initiative and to develop domain-specific scientific foundation models and autonomous laboratories.
key_facts.excerpt: Launch a New Golden Age Powered by AI for Science... fully fund and scale the Genesis Mission as the flagship national AI-for-science initiative... develop domain-specific scientific foundation models.

key_facts.fact: As an annex, Kratsios and OMB Director Russ Vought jointly issued the White House FY2028 R&D Priorities Memorandum directing agencies to implement the recommendations.
key_facts.excerpt: Director Kratsios and Director of the Office of Management and Budget (OMB) Russ Vought jointly issued the White House Fiscal Year 2028 R&D Priorities Memorandum.
